name: dsh-command-buddy-connect
description: DeepSeek Harness 的多账号模型线路插件：国内版 / 国际版 / Command Code 三条线路分区轮询与独立开关，WorkBuddy 每日自动签到，账号健康诊断，以及从桌面版直接读取凭据。A DeepSeek Harness plugin that serves model traffic through region-partitioned account pools with independent switches, adds WorkBuddy daily check-in, account health diagnosis, and reads credentials straight from the installed desktop app.
